scope: XGComputeTexture2DLayout (ordinal 5) and XGCreateTexture2DComputer (ordinal 9) for a bounded subset. Identical guest and XMem dependency; complete layouts and sampled element addresses compared against the supplied Xbox XG DLL.
subset: 78 color/block formats, eight square and rectangular shapes, including 1×1 and one-pixel edges, one or three mips and slices, one sample, shader-resource bind; linear swizzle with staging usage or 4 KiB swizzle with default or immutable usage; no CPU access flags, misc flags or explicit pitch. Other combinations are unsupported.
